description:
Google just unleashed gwscli, a revolutionary Rust CLI tool that transforms how AI agents interact with Google Workspace. With 100s of dynamically generated commands, your AI can now read emails, create slides, manage spreadsheets, and control your calendar directly from the terminal - no MCP server required. Built from the ground up specifically for agents, gwscli uses nested JSON structures and runtime documentation to minimize token usage while maximizing capabilities. This isn't just another CLI; it's a paradigm shift that challenges the future of MCP servers and promises to make every developer's workflow exponentially more powerful.
